svg.title: L2 Services -- Adobe Commerce on AWS, application tier
svg.desc: The internal load balancer spreads requests over Magento in two Availability Zones. Magento uses OpenSearch, ElastiCache for Redis, Aurora and EFS, and Aurora keeps its standby in the second zone.
